_comment: Shared hash-v2 vectors (followup 1287). The Rust verifier/writer (gateway-rust/src/audit_integrity.rs) and the Python writer (src/noomesh/gateway/audit_log.py) must both reproduce `canonical` and `entry_hash` for each `row` under `key`. `details` is Postgres's jsonb text; `timestamp_us` the stored microseconds. Never regenerate these to make a test pass: a change here invalidates every v2 row already written.

_comment_jsonb_renderings: What `$1::jsonb::text` returns for a writer's JSON. The v2 hash covers details as this text, so a Postgres whose rendering differs would fail every v2 row with details. Checked against a live server by audit_integrity.rs::the_v2_details_render_the_same_on_this_postgres (docs/reference/postgres.md, before a major upgrade).
